Msg: Received a payment request via email or WhatsApp? STOP. Verify offline. Always confirm the request directly with the sender through an in-person conversation before taking any action. It could be a phishing or smishing attempt.
MFA prompts you did not initiate must always be denied. If you receive an unexpected MFA request, it means someone has your password and is trying to get in. Deny it and contact IT immediately.
